notes: IMPORTANT fix to 1.3.9's own diagnostic: checkpoint.json was being written every ~5s on every main-loop pass (not just during a start), which risked filesystem corruption if a reset landed mid-write on a device that already resets unpredictably -- likely why the board became fully unresponsive for 10+ minutes after 1.3.9, worse than the bug it was meant to diagnose. Checkpoint writes are now limited to the 5 rare points inside start_run() only.
